system.description:
This reinforced quilted coat was developed by battlefield chirurgeons and temple hospices. Narrow pockets contain splints, bandages and basic instruments where they can be reached quickly. A properly stocked Hospice Jack counts as a basic healer's kit for the purpose of Administer First Aid, although not for Treat Wounds, surgery or other more involved Medicine actions.

On the sheet: declared as the tool for Administer First Aid (that action asks for no tool in the core table, so the jack is simply on hand).

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
